calibration_rule: Shared unlabeled public synthetic corpus; no calibration labels computed or used; identical serialized basis delivered before local training
cost_scope: Record dependency preparation, shared calibration, each host local feature/G,b preparation, direct transport/recovery/solve/persistence, separate post-seal evaluation; overlapping host phases must not be summed as elapsed time
head_coordinates: receiver value/risk/signed-event/event-rate/margin in actual feature_names order; shared calibration centering/scaling; final intercept
partition: Each host generates four own independent-source batches; early/late latent sum target; late-latent support and nuisance distribution differ between hosts
physical_model: Unmodified pinned SmallHCSN, dense float64, QVI boundary, full messages; all physical and recurrent parameters frozen
scope_limits: synthetic task and synthetic data, not real-user A-to-B
readout training on actual HCSN features, not inversion/training of the full nonlinear field
two configured physical hosts, not permissionless Sybil-resistant federation
local research model readout installation/reload, not native daemon product adoption
statistics_rule: G=X^T X; b=X^T(y-X parent); objective 0.5*sum((X action-residual)^2)+ridge/2*||action||^2; same parent, basis, provider and objective identifiers
test_policy: All 12 candidates and exact result hashes must be externally sealed in Git before test generation; no test-dependent tuning or backward boundary
test_preflight: Verify all 12 result/candidate seals, basis, model, parent+action and independent numerical references before generating any test source; fail closed on any mismatch
test_shift: New source IDs and random generators; arrival support expands 4..6 to 3..8; initial-margin support expands; no repeated training rows
transport: Existing authenticated direct USB4 SSH; eight unique contributions; out-of-order delivery/repetition; actual remote exit17 and durable restart; no controller training-byte relay
updated_parameters: difference of two class readouts, including intercept: 5*(width/2)+1
